title: Sales cum Service Executive (Field Travel, Gujarat/Maharashtra Region)
description:
Resident Sales cum Service Executive required for sales and service of scientific and pharmaceutical instruments in Gujrat, Maharashtra and Rajasthan Regions. The person should have preferably 2-3 year experience in sales cum service of scientific and laboratory instruments. He should be willing to travel throughout India.

**Sales cum Service Executive Duties and Responsibilities**

* Improve on the sales of products in the area assigned to you.
* Visit prospective clients/dealers in your territory on regular basis and showcase the best products and services offered by the organization to them
* Installation and servicing of the equipment at the end user site in your territory
* Give detailed description of products/services to customers, as well as the various ways they can be used to obtain maximum satisfaction
* Assist with direct sales in specific communities as directed by management.
* Preparing and sending weekly and monthly tour plans and sending it to the management.

**Resident Sales cum Service Executive Requirements**

* Minimum 2-3 years of experience as a Sales cum Service Engineer preferably having diploma/degree in electronics
* Possess good marketing skills for increasing customer base and sales
* Ability to provide installation and after sales services to the clients after relevant training at the company
* Willingness to travel across the assigned territory in a planned systematic manner.
* Possess strong persuasive skills for acquiring more customers and making more sales
* Possess strong confidence to speak to and convince people
* Highly self motivated, with the ability to maintain optimism at all times.

**Environmental & Scientific Instruments Co.** is a pioneer organization in the realms of scientific/pharmaceutical instruments with its head office located in Panchkula, near Chandigarh. The company is around 30 year old and a prominent Manufacturer, Supplier and Exporter of Spectrophotometers, Dissolution Apparatus, Disintegration Apparatus, Friability Apparatus, Melting Point Apparatus, Flame Photometer, pH Meters etc. The company is certified by ISO 9001:2015. The products can be viewed on **http://www.ei-instrument.com**

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* In which city are you currently residing?
* Do you have a 2 wheeler?
* Do you have any experience with lab/pharma instruments
* Do you have educational qualification in electrical/electronics or pharma

Experience:

* Sales/Service: 3 years (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

Job description:

**Job Description:**

About Sky Education Group

Sky Education Group is an education counselling and enrollment partner working with 28\+ universities across India. We help students and working professionals choose the right Online \& Distance UG and PG programmes based on their academic background, career goals and requirements.

We are looking for a Business Development Executive who has already worked/willing to start their career in the Online/Distance Higher Education / EdTech admission sales domain and can start handling leads with minimal training.

Fresher/Experience both can apply for this role.

We are specifically looking for candidates who already understand:

* Online \& Distance Education
* UG \& PG admission counselling
* University/course comparison
* B2C lead handling
* Telephonic counselling
* Follow\-up and objection handling
* Admission conversion
* CRM/lead management
* Closing the admission cycle

Key Responsibilities

* Handle **fresh and existing leads** through telephone calls, WhatsApp and other communication channels.
* Understand the student's **education, career goals, work experience and course requirements**.
* Counsel students for Online \& Distance UG/PG programmes such as:
* **BBA**
* **BCA**
* **B.Com**
* **MBA**
* **MCA**
* Other relevant UG/PG programmes
* Explain and compare universities, programmes, eligibility, fees, admission process and other relevant details.
* Counsel students regarding programmes offered through leading universities such as **NMIMS, LPU, Amity, Chandigarh University, Manipal University** and other partner universities.
* Handle student objections related to **fees, university selection, course validity, programme structure, placements, admission process and competitors**.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with interested prospects and move them towards admission.
* Coordinate with the admission/operations team until the student's admission process is successfully completed.
* Maintain accurate lead and follow\-up information in the CRM.
* Achieve **monthly admission and revenue targets**.
* Maintain high\-quality counselling while focusing strongly on **conversion and closures**.

What We Are Looking For Mandatory :

* **0\-2 years of relevant experience** in Online Education / Distance Education / EdTech admission sales will be preferred .
* Have experience selling **Online/Distance UG \& PG programmes will be beneficial** .
* Candidates who have previously worked with **Online University, EdTech, University Enrollment Partner, Education Consultancy or similar organizations** are preferred.
* Strong understanding of the **Online Education admission process**.
* Proven experience in **B2C telephonic counselling and sales conversion but not mandatory**.
* Comfortable handling a high volume of calls and follow\-ups.
* Strong communication skills in **Hindi \& English**.
* Strong convincing, negotiation and objection\-handling ability.
* Comfortable working with sales targets.
* Candidate should be able to **start handling leads with minimal training**.

Who Will Be a Strong Fit?

Someone who has previously worked as:

* Business Development Executive
* Career Counsellor – EdTech
* Inside Sales Executive – EdTech
* Online Education Counsellor
* University Admission Counsellor

and has actually converted Online/Distance Education leads into admissions.

Interview

Face\-to\-Face Interview / Walk\-in

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

title: Account Executive
description:
**Accounts Excicutive**

**Key ResponsibilitiesIf Financial/Accounting Focused (Common in Dealerships \& Showrooms):**

* **Daily Transactions:** Handle daily bookkeeping, journal entries, vendor payments, and petty cash management.
* **Reconciliation:** Perform bank reconciliations, cash book maintenance, and inspect accounts receivable/payable ledgers.
* **Automotive Invoicing:** Verify and process vehicle sales invoices, spare parts bills, and workshop service invoices.
* **Compliance:** Assist with statutory requirements like GST and TDS filings specific to vehicle transactions.
* **Reporting:** Prepare monthly MIS reports, financial statements, and coordinate with internal/external auditors.

**If Sales/Client\-Facing Focused (Field / B2B / Enterprise):**

* **Lead Generation:** Identify prospective B2B clients, corporate fleets, or dealership partners through market research.
* **Relationship Management:** Build and maintain long\-term partnerships with automotive clients and buyers.
* **Negotiation \& Closing:** Pitch automotive products/services (such as financing, insurance, fleet management, or software) and negotiate contracts.
* **After\-Sales Support:** Resolve client complaints, track account activities, and coordinate deliveries.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B.Com) for accounts roles, or Business/Marketing for sales roles.
* **Experience:** 1 to 5\+ years of relevant experience, preferably within an automobile dealership or manufacturing environment.
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in accounting software like Tally, advanced MS Excel, and general CRM tools.
* **Industry Knowledge:** Understanding of vehicle pricing, stock invoices, and automotive market dynamics.
* **Soft Skills:** Strong communication, negotiation, and organizational abilities.

If you want to tailor this further, tell me:

* Is the position focused more on **finance/accounting** or **sales/field business development**?
* What **experience level** or **software requirements** do you need to highlight?
